# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** eight (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>  
  _previously: six or seven years old (v2)_  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Change P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033), [v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is characterized by a neat and proper appearance, wearing a nicely starched white dress accented with a black sash. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that always remain neatly in place.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a quiet, lovely, and well-behaved child described as being very good, faithful, and neat. Characterized by her prim and proper demeanor, she comports herself like a model child by speaking demurely when addressed and maintaining silence otherwise. She is industrious, observant, and systematic, never needing to be told how to do a task twice and never forgetting her duties. Highly composed and placid, it takes a great deal to ruffle her composure even at eight years old, though her predictable nature is sometimes considered monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), +4 more_

## History

Dora Keith was brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alongside her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), though Davy's unruly behavior soon caused Dora to fall into a pigpen. Shortly after her arrival, Dora went missing and was found locked inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by her brother. Considered quiet and well-behaved by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Dora was frightened at school by ghost stories told by a classmate. Following the death of [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), money was left in trust to secure Dora and Davy's permanent residence at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Later, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinced Dora to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) with him to go fishing instead.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), +18 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora is Davy's twin sister. While Dora is known for her quiet perfection, Davy's unruly nature frequently causes her trouble, such as when he makes her fall into a pigpen or locks her inside a toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +22 more_

- Sibling of — twin sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +10 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dora.md)

Dora lives alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and maintains a friendly bond with her, warmly welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon her return home. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regards Dora as quiet and well-behaved, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) find themselves feeling a deeper affection for her mischievous brother.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcoming her affectionately on her return home (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
